name: Person
description: A human being known to the user — themself, family, friends, colleagues, contacts.

attributes.name: aliases
attributes.description: Alternative names/nicknames used to refer to this person.

attributes.name: descriptions
attributes.description: How this one has been described, in whoever's words — several are normal, because people describe the same thing differently and each telling is worth keeping.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: The latest of this one's descriptions, as one string. Writing it adds a description; they all live there.

relations.partner: their spouse or partner — one at a time
relations.authority: whom they manage; managed_by — their manager
relations.service: services they provide; served_by — their doctor, landlord, recruiter

what_to_say: their full name as the user says it, who they are to the user, where they live, when they were born if it came up — enough to know them again when the name is said differently next time
brief: a human being known to the user
